punchline: There was no ahead 2/3 on that motor, and the captain's order was carried anyway.
thirty_sec: During a reactor scram drill, Captain Marquet had the officer of the deck order ahead 2/3 on a motor that had no such setting; the officer knew, and obeyed because the captain said so. Marquet vowed never to give another order.
question: When did someone last carry out your passing remark even though it may have been wrong?
key_contrast: A casual remark from the top carries the weight of an order.
